title: BPW-2026-0581
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0581
CD 6
AFE – US ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $20,200 for a Construction Period Servicing Fee for the term October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2027.
(AE27761528Y, Fund 761 - Sewer Construction & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50E700)
